wpt_reference.surrogate_cssom_exclusion: production API accepts UTF-8 bytes, not JavaScript UTF-16 code units

certified_preprocessing: NUL bytes become U+FFFD before CSS parsing
CRLF CR and form-feed become LF before CSS parsing
malformed UTF-8 becomes deterministic U+FFFD replacement
WTF-8 surrogate sequences become one U+FFFD replacement
preprocessing allocations are charged to ComputedStyle
raw and preprocessed byte counts are reported separately
deliberate_exclusions: full CSS Syntax or WPT conformance claim
